howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose target page size
howto.text: A4, Letter, Legal, Tabloid, or custom dimensions in millimeters/inches.

howto.name: Download the resized PDF
howto.text: PrivaTools scales each page's MediaBox to the target. Content is preserved at relative position; aspect ratio is maintained.

faq.q: Will my content be cropped if I resize to a smaller page?
faq.a: No — content scales proportionally. If you want to crop instead, use the Crop tool.
Resize changes the page dimensions (scales content). Crop changes the visible region without scaling.
Text is vector-based in PDFs, so it scales perfectly. Only embedded raster images can lose quality on extreme upscale.
